status: DRAFTED at $0 before any model of this study exists; REGISTERED (frozen, its sha256 bound into the phase grant) only on the maintainer's authorization, and never amended after the first trained result of this study exists

arms.Projected-1123M-topk200: NEW: the 1.123B student (four independent projections + identity-initialized learnable SiLU gates; design :: architecture, initialization), trained with D4-Augmented's data and recipe under the new KD protocol (design :: objective, recipe_overrides, arm_overrides), two seeds
arms.D4-Augmented-topk200: NEW, the matched control: D4 Top-1 trained with D4-Augmented's data and recipe under the SAME new KD protocol, two seeds, trained once
arms.D4-Augmented (H1-PA, old protocol): REUSED, descriptive only: H1-PA's two D4-Augmented units, trained with full-vocabulary KD at every position; never retrained, never a matched arm

isolated_variable: the student architecture and its initialization; teacher, data, KD protocol, recipe, seeds, evaluation set, decoding protocol and inference engine version are the same in both decided arms

inside_the_variable._: these change together and P is never read as any one of them
inside_the_variable.compute: 1.18x the training FLOPs per supervised position with the teacher's forward (1.42x student-only); 1.49x the inference FLOPs at context 4,096
inside_the_variable.width_mechanism: 112 trainable per-site bases (4 per layer) with 112 learnable SiLU gates vs one fixed global basis
inside_the_variable.output_head: the teacher's 2,560-wide tied head, frozen, vs D4's projected 1,024-wide tied head, frozen
inside_the_variable.inference_implementation: the projected student runs vLLM's out-of-tree model, D4 a stock Qwen3 in the same vLLM version

seed_pairing: P pairs the two arms by training-seed number; every directional label needs both seeds' own estimates on its side

R.role: descriptive: the training protocol's change on one initialization, data and seed pair

multiplicity: P is the only decided comparison, at its own 95% interval; within it the four static-axis contrasts (eval-set-1's registered static axes, above) are a Holm family at alpha 0.05 (h1_statistics)

set.validity_mask: v1 (6 items excluded; formal 714 = 570 static + 144 interactive)
set.scoring_protocol: each component's scorer.formal_protocol (v2 for eval-set-1), unchanged
set.action_protocol: v2 (the protocol the interactive episodes are generated and replayed under)
set.every_item: every item of every unit is generated for every checkpoint; the validity mask and core decide which rows enter the formal numbers

seed_rule.namespace: the evaluated unit's key <component>__<unit> (e.g. fluid_reasoning_720__dev_v1, stage3_capability_846__gsm8k): uncapped_eval reads it from the prompt file's stem, which dose_driver.evaluate_all stages as <component>__<unit>.jsonl; run_battery takes it as --seed-namespace
seed_rule.independent_of: the model, the arm and the training seed: every checkpoint draws with the same seed for the same item, turn and sample

decoding.binding: the driver passes it to every evaluation and refuses a configuration without it, a generation already on the volume recorded under another protocol, and any generation summary that does not carry it; it never falls back to greedy decoding

evaluation.context: 8,192 trained context; each sample generates until EOS or the context minus its prompt (AGENTS.md P18); degeneration stops are recorded, never re-scored as correct
evaluation.every_checkpoint: two D4-Augmented-topk200 and two Projected-1123M-topk200 checkpoints, each generated once under this protocol; the projected checkpoints through the out-of-tree vLLM model after its engine admission (independent_gated_design.json :: evaluation.engine_admission)

primary_measure: correctness on the 570 formal static items of fluid_reasoning_720 (dev_v1), one nucleus_v1 sample per item and seed, clustered by rule family. Its four static axes are eval-set-1's registered ones: three of AGENTS.md P10.2's four primary axes (task-contained deduction, inductive rule discovery, compositional generalization) and abstract/analogical reasoning, a registered sub-category reported as its own diagnostic axis; the fourth primary axis, interactive adaptation and planning, is the 144 interactive episodes, exploratory

labels.GO: the interval lies wholly above +5 pp and both seeds' estimates are above +5 pp
labels.NO_GO: the interval and both seeds' estimates lie inside (-5, +5) pp and neither arm is below 2%
labels.REVERSED: the interval lies wholly below -5 pp and both seeds' estimates are below -5 pp
labels.NOT_RESOLVED: both arms below 2% (flag FLOOR); one arm below 2% is flagged FLOOR_<arm> beside the label

decision_rule.same_rule_as: the H1-PA, mixed-calibration and historical projected-residual decisions (constants identical except the new bootstrap seed)

reported_beside: each static axis per arm and seed, unseen-rule and unseen-format tiers
every eval-set-1 unit, correct AND usable side by side over its formal items
protocol integrity: natural termination, degeneration stops, context-limit hits
generation lengths (reasoning and answer tokens) per unit
training: loss curves, validation CE and Top-200 + tail KD at every validation step, the KD diagnostics (teacher tail mass, target-in-support share)
the initialization error of the projected student against W0 and against the teacher, per layer and site and end to end
the gates: alpha mean, mean |alpha|, |alpha| quantiles and gradient norms during training, and per layer and gate at the end; projection orthogonality and singular values at step 0 and at the end
parameters, training FLOPs, inference FLOPs, KV cache, measured step time, peak training memory, inference throughput and weight bytes, each apart
R: the new protocol's D4-Augmented beside H1-PA's, descriptive
never: changing this rule, its constants, the evaluation set, the mask, the scorers, the decoding protocol or the KD protocol after a result of this study is seen
a pooled score across units, or usable rollout, KL, loss or PCA energy read as reasoning
selecting, dropping or re-running a seed for its result; a complete valid unit is never rerun
claiming a same-size advantage: neither parameters nor FLOPs are matched
describing the Top-200 + tail KL as the full-vocabulary KL
comparing with Research A's hybrid-teacher students as if they were a controlled pair (a different teacher lineage)
